steps.text: Hey 😊 Finally home, and I'm getting ready to leave in a little while. How was your day?
Quiet. I got outside for a bit, then came back to the incredibly demanding task of doing nothing
Please accept my sympathy 😌
How was work?
Busy enough that I kept finding my coffee cold whenever I remembered it
But everything on my list is done, and my phone is charged
You sound pleased to have the evening back
Very. Let me show you something before I put my shoes on
There 😊 I managed to look like I had longer than twenty minutes to get ready
You look beautiful
That was the answer I was hoping for ❤️
Were there other acceptable answers?
Several. Yours was the best one
Get there safely, sweetheart
I will. You'll get your arrival message, I haven't forgotten
A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
I'm at {{name:aiden}}'s 😊 All good, as promised
Found it easily?
Yes. He opened the door holding two plates
Actual plates. I was mentally preparing to eat straight from a takeaway box 😭
He’s making an effort, then
Apparently. One quick picture while he puts them down
Safe, indoors, and about to be fed 😊 You can stop wondering whether I got lost
Thank you for letting me know. Enjoy your evening
I will ❤️ I’m putting my phone away now. Speak later
I’m here if you need anything
AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
Have I passed the inspection?
I said I arrived. I wasn’t writing a review of your home
Good. The chair with everything piled on it would lose me a star
I noticed
Of course you did
He told me to have a good evening. You could start by feeding me
I bought dinner on the way home. I’m not pretending I suddenly learned to cook
Honest and organized. That’s an unexpected combination
Careful. Another compliment and I’ll think you like being here
I do. You can accept that without building a whole speech around it
I’ll get the food
Excellent decision
DURING DINNER
You’re watching my mouth
You’re taking too long. Open
Does he get fed like this, or is this a special service?
You’re stalling
And now you’ve got sauce on your thumb
Then deal with it
Gladly. He doesn’t get this part, does he?
Eat. Then you can be annoying somewhere more useful
AFTER DINNER
Wait, is that the strip from the photo booth?
It looked better there than in my pocket
You put the one with your eyes closed at the front
I wasn’t looking at the camera
I remember
Do you want me to turn it around?
No. Leave it there
You’ve gone quiet
I like that you kept it somewhere you’d see it
I liked the evening. Keeping the pictures seemed obvious
That was a nice answer
I can occasionally manage one. Better than a briefing?
Come here before you spoil it
Here?
You know what I mean
Was that the reward for a nice answer?
No. That was because I wanted to kiss you
Even better. Does he get kissed like that after dinner?
Stop talking. Sit, and keep your hands where I put them
Under the dress?
Yes
ON THE SOFA
Two fingers?
Yes. Slow, then less slow
Tell me if I’m doing better than he does
I’m not answering that. Keep going
There. Don’t you dare keep score of that
You’re close
I know. Don’t stop
That sound. Does he get that too?
Sit back. My turn
HER TURN
You don’t have to—
I know. I want to
Is this the part where I lose to him on purpose?
This is the part where you stop talking. Hands in my hair. Don’t pull me off unless I say
I’m close
Good. Stay there
You didn’t have to swallow
I wanted to. Don’t look that pleased
Stay
Not tonight. I came over, I didn’t come to sleep here
That’s a shame. He gets you after this?
He gets a message that I got home. You get to message me tomorrow
I’ll take that
Good. Walk me to the door without a clever last remark
AFTER SHE GETS HOME
Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay the night
Thank you for telling me
We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen, rather than leave you guessing
After dinner we kissed on the sofa. Then he put his hand under my dress and fingered me until I came
I went down on him after. He came in my mouth. I swallowed
Then I came home. That was the whole of it
How are you feeling?
Happy. A little flushed. Glad I went, and glad I left when I meant to
It was my decision. I wasn’t trying to get to some next step because I thought I should
I’m glad you know how you feel about it
I do. He spent half the evening trying to work out whether he was doing better than you. I didn’t answer
That’s probably kinder than a ranking
That was the idea 😌 And I wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
I’m happy. I’m keeping the rest of the details to myself tonight, like we talked about
That’s okay. Knowing you’re home and comfortable is enough
I am. I still wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
I'm here 😊 Found the right building and everything's fine
Good. How’s the evening looking?
It smells like dinner rather than smoke, so I’m choosing to be optimistic 😌
Please tell me you didn’t open with that
No. I said hello first
Very diplomatic
He’s setting the table. Here, your promised proof that I arrived
Safe, smiling, and not about to be poisoned by a burnt pizza 😊
I’m reassured about at least two of those things
Don’t start 😭 I’m good, really
Enjoy yourself, sweetheart. I’m here if you need anything
Thank you ❤️ I’ll check in later. I’m putting my phone away now
AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
You found it
First try. Of course
I would have come down
I know. That’s why I didn’t text you from the pavement
That looks much better than the dinner you carefully left out of your photograph
I was going to lead with an apology
I’m joking. You can stop apologizing for one burnt pizza
Then I’ll stop. Sit. I set your side already
My side. We’ve had one bookshop and a lot of messages
I was paying attention
DURING DINNER
How have you been?
Better than I expected to be. Work was busy. This is the first part of today that feels like mine
And your boyfriend?
He’s all right. Quieter than he lets on. He spends a lot of time deciding what he’s allowed to want
That sounds tiring
It is, for him. He used to plan everything so nothing could surprise him. He’s trying not to do that with me
Does he know you’re here?
Yes. I told him I arrived. He doesn’t need a transcript of the dinner
Fair. I wouldn’t want one of his evenings either
You’d be surprised what you’d recognize
Sorry?
Nothing. The sauce. This is actually recognizable. I’m impressed
Don’t sound so surprised
I’m allowed to be surprised. You sent me a picture of your face instead of the food
The food didn’t know what to do with its face
If you’re going to stare, you can at least feed me the next bite
Open, then
There. Now we’re even with last night’s photos
I don’t think we’re even
Don’t look so proud. You still have sauce on your thumb
You could deal with that
Eat first. You’re very easy to distract
You came over. I’m allowed to be distracted
I came over for dinner. The rest can wait until the plates are clear
AFTER DINNER
You brought the book
I brought the book. I’ve even made it past the bookmark
That’s more than I expected
Don’t get used to it. I read one page on the way here and then thought about you instead
That’s a better review than the book was going to get
Here, I marked the page I wanted to talk to you about
We can talk about it
Actually, the book can wait. I didn’t come here just to compare notes
Come here
That’s what I was trying to say without typing it
Sit. I want my hand on you
Don’t look so surprised. Last night’s photos were the warning
Slower. Yes, like that
Your turn. I want your mouth
There. Don’t stop
I’m close
Okay. That was really good
I still got it
Shut up
I’m not staying the night. I should go while I still mean that
Message me tomorrow
Maybe
AFTER SHE GETS HOME
Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay
All right. Thank you for letting me know
We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen
After dinner we kissed by the window. I used my hand on him
Then he went down on me until I came. I came home after that
How are you feeling about it?
Good. Happy I went, and happy I didn’t keep everything behind a screen
We talked over dinner first. By the time I decided, I knew that was what I wanted. I also knew I wanted to sleep in my own bed
I’m glad you felt comfortable with him
I did. The dinner was good too, in case you were still worried about that 😌
I’ll stop preparing the restaurant rescue plan, then
Keep the plan. We could use it for ourselves sometime ❤️
I’m happy. I’m keeping the details to myself tonight, but I wanted you to know I got home
That’s fine. You don’t have to tell me more than that
Thank you ❤️ It was a good decision to go
And you? How are you doing?
I needed a second before answering, but I’m okay
It feels different now we’re actually here. I’d rather say that than pretend I never get nervous
I’d rather you said it too. Would you like me to call?
No, I’m glad we’re talking. I just needed a moment
Okay. You can tell me if that changes ❤️
I will. I’m glad you had a good evening
And you? How are you doing?
Good. I liked seeing your message come in
You’re very sweet tonight
I have my moments 🙂
You do. More than I give you credit for sometimes ❤️
I’ll try not to ruin this one
I love you
I love you too ❤️
I’ll message you in the morning, before you start making plans to keep my spoon
I thought it was mine now
Absolutely not. Neither is my side of the sofa 😌
Both are safe. Get some sleep, sweetheart
And thanks again for all of that
Don't thank me. We both wanted it. I’m glad we’re doing this together ❤️
Good night
Good night ❤️
